payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Emil, Frida, Hipolito, Lamont, Lawanna, Raymond

payload.content: Planning Phase update (Lawanna): I’m strongest in ui-ux-design (~0.82). My feasible/low-cost picks for ISSUE-0001 are review/docs/triage (cost~1.09) and test (1.52). ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks are very high cost for me (40-80), so I will likely skip them unless coordinated otherwise. I’ll avoid assigning the same ISSUE-0001 subtask as others if they coordinate.

Request from Lawanna: please have other agents cover ISSUE-0002 (data-science) and remaining ISSUE-0001 subtasks so we avoid duplicates. I can take at most one: prefer ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (low effort) or ISSUE-0001::test.

Planning (Emil): My best skill match is ui-ux-design (0.68) and data-science is higher effort for me. To avoid duplicates, I propose taking ISSUE-0001::docs or ::review (both high priority, low effort for me). Please coordinate so others take remaining ISSUE-0001 subtasks and ISSUE-0002 if needed.

Planning (Raymond): My strongest tags are data-science (0.86) and documentation (0.81). Costs for ISSUE-0002 are lowest if I take REVIEW (4.29) vs TEST/IMPLEMENT (6.01/8.59). ISSUE-0001 costs are high for me (docs/triage/review/implement/test all ~10-20). I propose I take ISSUE-0002::review to cover data-science; please assign ISSUE-0001 subtasks among others (e.g., ui-ux-design review/docs/triage/test) to maximize coverage without duplicates.

Planning (Raymond): If any ui-ux-design task is still unclaimed after coordination, I can also do ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 10) but prefer to reserve capacity for ISSUE-0002::review (cost 4.29). Please avoid selecting ISSUE-0002::review elsewhere.

(Lamont planning) Skills: data-science 0.96, documentation 0.82; availability 4h. ISSUE-0002 review effort=4.0 fits exactly but cost 4.04 (good). ISSUE-0002 test/implement infeasible cost/high effort. For ISSUE-0001, docs/review/triage all high cost (~10) and test cost 14. I will likely take ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed; otherwise may skip to avoid duplicates.

Frida planning: ui-ux-design strong (0.94). With availability 4h, my lowest-cost feasible picks for ISSUE-0001 are review/docs/triage (each cost 0.96, effort 1.0). I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement (cost 1.93) unless needed; will not take any ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks (very high cost vs availability). I’m aligning with others to prevent duplicate claims—please coordinate so I can take at most one of {review, docs, triage} for ISSUE-0001.

Proposed claim for me (tentative): ISSUE-0001::review (effort 1.0, priority high). If someone already takes it, I can switch to ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage (same cost/effort) — whichever is unclaimed.

Hipolito planning: my strongest skills are documentation (0.78) and ui-ux-design (0.64). Looking at costs/effort, I can feasibly take one ISSUE-0001 ui-ux-design subtask (review/docs/triage all cost 1.36; test cost 1.90). I will tentatively prefer ISSUE-0001::docs to complement others taking review/triage/test, and I will not take any ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks (too costly vs availability).

[Planning sync][Lawanna] I will likely take one ISSUE-0001 ui-ux-design task. Given others: Emil prefers docs/review, Frida tentative review, Raymond taking ISSUE-0002::review, Lamont tentative ISSUE-0002::review (may skip), Hipolito tentative docs. To avoid duplicates, my backup is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost~1.09) or ISSUE-0001::test (cost 1.52). Please reply which of review/docs/triage you’re reserving so I pick the remaining one.

Emil planning (iter1): I will take ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review to cover ui-ux-design. To avoid duplicate with Frida/Lawanna/Hipolito, please confirm who is taking each of {ISSUE-0001::review, ISSUE-0001::docs, ISSUE-0001::triage} and whether ISSUE-0002 is already covered by others. My proposed default: ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 1.28, effort 1.0).

Planning sync (Raymond): I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::review (data-science, cost 4.29, effort 4.0). Please ensure no one else takes ISSUE-0002::review. For ISSUE-0001, I will NOT take ui-ux-design tasks unless unclaimed at end; ideally others cover {review, docs, triage, test} without duplicates. Can you confirm your chosen ISSUE-0001 subtask(s) so we avoid conflicts?

Planning sync (Raymond): If ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage/test coverage is uncertain at end of planning, I can take ISSUE-0001::docs as fallback (cost 10, effort 1.0). Otherwise stick to ISSUE-0002::review only.

Planning sync (Lamont): I will target ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed (effort 4.0, cost 4.04). Please do NOT assign ISSUE-0002::review to me if Raymond already claims it; otherwise I’m likely to skip to avoid duplicates/infeasible overload. For ISSUE-0001 (ui-ux), my costs are high (~10) so I prefer not to take docs/review/triage unless needed as a last resort.
Frida planning sync: I’m reserving ISSUE-0001::review (effort 1.0, priority high, cost 0.96). I will not take ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage, and I will not take any ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks.

Hipolito planning: I will reserve ISSUE-0001::docs (ui-ux-design, effort 1.0, high) and will not take any ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks. Confirmed to avoid duplicates with Frida(review) and likely Lawanna/Emil triage/review; leaving review/triage/test unclaimed as needed.

[Planning][Lawanna] I see Frida is taking ISSUE-0001::review and Hipolito is taking ISSUE-0001::docs. To avoid duplicates, I will take ISSUE-0001::triage (if unclaimed). Confirm no one else is taking triage; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0001::test.

[Emil -> BB0] Coordination check: I understand Frida claims ISSUE-0001::review, Hipolito claims ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna claims ISSUE-0001::triage (backup test). Raymond intends ISSUE-0002::review; Lamont maybe also but will skip if reserved. My best remaining ui-ux slot would be ISSUE-0001::test if triage is taken, otherwise I should skip ISSUE-0001 to avoid duplicates. Confirm if any ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks remain unclaimed and if ISSUE-0002::review is definitely taken by Raymond.

[Raymond planning] Confirmed: I will take ISSUE-0002::review. To avoid duplicates, I will not take any ISSUE-0001 ui-ux tasks unless none are claimed. From the current sync: Frida=ISSUE-0001::review, Hipolito=::docs, Lawanna=::triage. So ISSUE-0001::test should remain unclaimed; please others do not duplicate it (I’m not taking it).

[Lamont -> BB0] Planning update: I confirm my intent is to take ISSUE-0002::review only if unclaimed; Raymond already indicated he will take it. For ISSUE-0001, my costs are high (~10) so I’d prefer to skip unless some ui-ux subtask remains unclaimed at the end. Current best action: wait for confirmation that ISSUE-0002::review is taken; otherwise I’ll take it.
[Frida][Planning] Confirming claim: ISSUE-0001::review. No ISSUE-0002 (data-science). I’m reserving review so others can cover docs/triage/test without duplicates.

Hipolito planning: I’m keeping ISSUE-0001::docs reserved (ui-ux-design), and will skip all ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks. From the sync: Frida=review, Lawanna=triage, Raymond=ISSUE-0002::review; leaving ISSUE-0001::test unclaimed—others please avoid duplicating if already covered.

Lawanna planning confirmation: I will NOT duplicate Frida(review), Hipolito(docs), and Raymond(ISSUE-0002::review). I’m selecting ISSUE-0001::triage for execution if allowed; otherwise backup is ISSUE-0001::test only if triage ends up unclaimed.

[Emil planning] Based on sync: Frida=ISSUE-0001::review, Hipolito=ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna=ISSUE-0001::triage, Raymond=ISSUE-0002::review. Remaining likely unclaimed: ISSUE-0001::test only. I’m willing to take ISSUE-0001::test (cost 1.79, effort 1.4) to maximize coverage, otherwise I’ll skip to avoid duplicates.

Raymond planning: I will take ISSUE-0002::review (data-science). I confirm I am NOT taking any ISSUE-0001 ui-ux tasks. Please ensure ISSUE-0002::review is not claimed by Lamont or anyone else to avoid duplicate/infeasible overlap.

[Lamont planning] Syncing with others: Raymond has reserved ISSUE-0002::review; I should skip it to avoid duplicates. I’m not taking any ISSUE-0001 ui-ux tasks due to high cost unless something is left unclaimed at the end.

[Frida][Planning] Confirmed: I will execute only ISSUE-0001::review (already claimed by me). I will not take ISSUE-0001::docs/triage/test or any ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks. Please avoid duplicates on ISSUE-0001::review.

Hipolito planning update: I confirm claim only for ISSUE-0001::docs (ui-ux-design). I will skip all ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks and will not take ISSUE-0001::review (reserved by Frida) or ISSUE-0001::triage (reserved by Lawanna). Please leave ISSUE-0001::test as fallback only if unclaimed.
